overview.description: The Invesco Galaxy Solana ETF (QSOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that seeks to track the spot price of Solana, less then trust expenses and other liabilities. QSOL was launched on Dec 15, 2025 and is issued by Invesco.
